scope: CLI and creation-only HTTPS setup-key UI; no native browser or physical-device proof from this receipt.

initialRed.description: Missing new CLI flags caused seven failing assertions across configuration and partial-option cases; default loopback case passed.

firstGreen.description: The original cases passed, with an additional real invalid-TLS-file admission case. Server construction was mocked; real configuration validation rejected before library admission.

bindRed.description: Injected constructor EADDRINUSE and EADDRNOTAVAIL escaped the HTTPS CLI boundary as OSError.

bindGreen.description: HTTPS startup OSError now receives fixed bind/port/library-access guidance. The default loopback OSError is re-raised unchanged.

coverage: Default positional server call and actual bound loopback URL remain unchanged.
Supplying any incomplete combination of the five HTTPS options fails before server construction.
Complete options call the configuration builder before the server, printing only the public origin.
Configuration errors do not print a traceback, setup input or private filesystem paths.
Real invalid certificate input leaves the existing test library unchanged.
Occupied-port and unavailable-address constructor errors are sanitized only in HTTPS mode.
cliVerification.boundary: CLI success, constructor-order and bind-error cases use controlled mocks. This is not a real-listener or TLS-handshake measurement.

staticVerification.evidence: Observed silent successful compilation in the retained execution session; no separate compile log was produced.

clientContract.status: Same-origin GET /api/status; only room creation is gated until transport mode and authority requirement are known.
clearing: On leaving room creation, opening a seat or returning home.
clientContract.ownership: Retired status and identity callbacks cannot activate an old room or unlock newer identity work; a received seat may be retained for explicit recovery.
clientContract.retry: No automatic replay of room creation. Failed or interrupted responses preserve name/title fields and require deliberate retry.
preserved: Existing invitation and saved-seat flows do not require the setup key.
Explicit local audio enablement and existing shared playback algorithm remain unchanged.
Setup key is not saved, put in links, echoed, or used as participant authority.

configurationLimits.note: File, address and TLS admission are delegated to the separately owned transport configuration implementation; this receipt does not claim its full protocol verification.

sanitization: No setup keys, participant capabilities, certificate private material or their values are copied into this receipt. Log contents are referenced only by length and hash.
